notes.title: The Kaleidoscope Expansion
notes.content:
[b][i]Something is different about Tattletail...[/i][/b] ːtattletailː[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27290917/41b3fd7338e3f78ed9c412d0fdea82f529988f77.png[/img]

Surprise!! ːgiftegg_greenː The Kaleidoscope Expansion is a [b]whole new campaign[/b] that tells a very different story about the events of Christmas 1998. New levels, new story, new scares, and best of all, it's included in this update [b]totally free.[/b]

ːmamatattleː Play The Kaleidoscope from the main menu by pressing the icon on the bottom right of the screen. The Kaleidoscope Expansion is [i]only[/i] accessible after you have completed the main story at least once.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]The Kaleidoscope[/b] is now available on the main menu once the main story has been completed (with any ending)
    [*]New voice lines for Tattletail & friends
    [*]New secrets and lore to discover
    [*]Mysterious consequences
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added support for Inverted Mouse control
    [*]Fixed some screen effects issues
[/list]

This update is a huge "thank you" to all our Tattletail fans. You can talk about The Kaleidoscope on our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/568090/discussions/]discussion board[/url]. Me love youuuu hehehee

notes.title: The Gift Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27290917/6a9fa8e7944e25edd969606a349df4d58b747033.png[/img]

ːgifteggː Wow!! Tattletail is still a freshly hatched egg but we're blown away by the response so far. Thanks so much for your feedback and for playing and sharing the game :3 OK anyway here's the good stuff:

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Secret ending[/b]... only if you've been good.
[*][b]Special reward[/b] for getting the new ending. I can't say what it is.
[*][b]Level Select[/b] now available if you've completed the game once.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved hint system to help make the monster mechanics more clear.
[*]Updated VHS Commercial scene.
[*]Mouse sensitivity should be greatly improved for those having issues.
[*]Whoops. Waygetter Electronics retired the Tattletail with a white ring around its nose earlier in '98. We have updated it to show a more historically accurate Tattletail with a fully red nose.
[/list]

Well... we're gonna get back to work. Post your feedback on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/568090/discussions/]discussion board[/url], and tell a friend about Tattletail!! It makes a great "GIFT" *wink* Ok me go night night ːtattletailː LOL

notes.title: Donut County dev unleashes Furby horror in Tattletail
notes.content: A horror game putting me in a room with a Furby would be spooky enough for me; those things are terrifying. Force me to care for a Furby while also avoiding the wrath of its bloodthirsty mamabot and no, no thank you, no, that’s kind but no, no thank you. You, however, may be interested in Tattletail [Steam page]. It’s a first-person horror game set around Christmas 1998, starring a small child playing with the year’s hottest toy when bad things happen. It was released a few days after Christmas, fittingly, by a small team including Ben Esposito of Donut County and Arcane Kids fame.
